semiconductor_relevance: High — Iwaki Pumps specializes in chemical and pneumatic pumps used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Iwaki Pumps (Shanghai) Co., Ltd is a leading manufacturer of chemical pumps that provide solutions for fluid management in semiconductor production. Their product offerings include magnetic drive centrifugal pumps, diaphragm metering pumps, and pneumatic bellow pumps, all designed to meet the rigorous demands of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Magnetic drive centrifugal pumps for severe operation conditions
Diaphragm metering pumps for precise chemical dosing
Pneumatic bellow pumps specifically designed for semiconductor applications

regional_presence.China: Iwaki has a significant presence in China, focusing on providing tailored solutions for local semiconductor manufacturers.
